title: Movie Recommendation System
summary: A movie discovery app that recommends films similar to the one you choose using cosine similarity.
points: Built a movie recommendation system that helps users discover films based on their selected movie.
Processed movie metadata, including genres, keywords, cast and crew, to identify similarities between films.
Used TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity to convert movie information into numerical features and measure how closely movies are related.
Generated personalized recommendations by ranking movies according to their similarity scores.
Integrated movie posters using the TMDB API to create a more engaging and interactive user experience.
Deployed the application with Streamlit so users can explore movie recommendations online.
